title: SWF: DefineFont3 and DefineFontInfo2 tag encoding
description: Test that FontItem library items produce DefineFont3 (tag 75) or DefineFontInfo2 (tag 62) tags in exported SWF. Verify: (1) tag 75 appears when a font is used in a text field, (2) font name is encoded correctly as counted string, (3) bold/italic flags set correctly in FontFlagsItalic/FontFlagsBold bits. Also test that an unused font does NOT produce DefineFont3 tags.
